text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as the autumn Tenno Sho is approaching, I'm getting ready to go home after work when…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hi, Trainer! What's the haps?
choice_data_list: Just finishing up. What brings you here so late?
Just finishing up. What brings you here so late?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hi, Trainer! What's the haps?
choice_data_list: Just finishing up. What brings you here so late?
Just finishing up. What brings you here so late?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You can't tell from my outfit? I'm going to do some training!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Senior-year racers are as fast as they come, and some super-talented newer students will be entering too…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So I'm mega-ultra eager to get to work. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Teehee, you know me so well. I'm itching to get out there and run with the little ones!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But I really am pushing myself hard. I'm doing everything I can to ensure this is a fun race!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So I was thinking… If it's okay, I was hoping you'd join me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Let's work up a sweat and get that gleaming glow of youth!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: This is a good time for training. It's not as hot at night.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: …Hm? It looks like there's someone else here.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Woo-hoo! I improved my time again!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Okay, one more lap! I need to focus on my pace this time.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I've gotta get… amped to the max!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Spe is training all alone at this hour…
choice_data_list: She looks like she's enjoying her practice.
She looks like she's enjoying her practice.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I can feel how eager she is to run.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hey, why don't we train somewhere else? I don't want to interrupt her.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm sure we'll run together one day, so keep at it, Spe…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, a press conference is held for the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A list of runners has already been handed out before the conference. However…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Why won't you show me the list?!
choice_data_list: I thought it would be more fun this way.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hmph… What a meanie…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess I'll find out soon enough when the press conference starts!

text_block_list.name: MC A
text_block_list.text: The press conference with the participants of the autumn Tenno Sho will now begin.

text_block_list.name: MC A
text_block_list.text: If the first runner could take the stage, please.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: O-okay! I'm so nervous being the first one to speak…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Wha?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um, my name is Special Week! I'm so happy to be here!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: We hear that you've been training particularly hard in preparation for the race.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes, but I've been so excited that it didn't really feel like hard work!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thanks to all of it, I'm in good shape. Actually, I'm feeling the best I've ever felt!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: You mentioned being excited. Is there anything special that has you so eager?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm excited because I think it's going to be the most fun race ever!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I watched Grass—I mean, Grass Wonder—in the Yasuda Kinen, and it was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It was so exciting to see her run with everything she had!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But as much as I enjoyed watching it, I was also really jealous… It looked more fun to be a runner than a spectator!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: You felt that you wanted to join a race like that?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I thought I wasn't good enough, and that I wouldn't be able to make the race fun…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But I continued to push myself, because there's someone I really admire—someone I want to catch up to!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: She taught me the joy of running, and in the autumn Tenno Sho, I'll finally be able to pass her on the track.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I will… I will win against Maruzensky!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ohhh!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I guess this is why you didn't show me the list of participants…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky continues to watch as Special Week speaks onstage.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe, look at her… I'm so excited, I can't stop grinning.
choice_data_list: I bet it's going to be a fun race!
I bet it's going to be a fun race!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It sure will… I accept your challenge, Spe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the stage is set for a big showdown with Special Week at the autumn Tenno Sho!
